Prophecy: An Appointed Day of Judgment by the Risen Man
ProphecySummary: Preaching at Athens, Paul says God has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man he has ordained, giving assurance of this by raising him from the dead.
Fulfillment: Awaited. The resurrection, cited as the assurance, has occurred; the appointed day of universal judgment itself has not yet occurred.
